Question: When Ringo places his marbles into bags with \(6\) marbles per bag, he has \(4\) marbles left over. When Paul does the same with his marbles, he has \(3\) marbles left over. Ringo and Paul pool their marbles and place them into as many bags as possible, with \(6\) marbles per bag. How many marbles will be left over?
Solution:
The marbles already in full bags can stay there. Ringo's and Paul's leftover marbles combine to give \(4+3=7\) marbles. These fill one additional bag of \(6\), leaving
\[7-6=1.\]
Since \(1<6\), another full bag cannot be made. The answer is \(\boxed{1}\) marble, choice A.
